link_notes: No paper text in the digest; the repo is synthcity, a library that includes PATEGAN among many generators, so sources are thin for this method alone.

open_release.rationale: The synthcity README describes PATEGAN as giving tight differential privacy guarantees.

quotes.text: allowing to tightly bound the influence of any individual sample on the model, resulting in tight differential privacy guarantees and thus an improved performance over models with the same guarantees.

pipeline_testing.rationale: No testing or format-conformance use of PATEGAN in the README.

ml_augmentation.rationale: Only the repo description mentions data augmentation for the library as a whole, not PATEGAN specifically.

statistical_replication.rationale: The library offers fidelity metrics, but nothing ties them to PATEGAN specifically.

causal_inference.rationale: No causal framing for PATEGAN in the README.

education.rationale: Tutorials teach the library, not PATEGAN specifically.

benchmarking.rationale: PATEGAN is listed as a reference model in a benchmarking library, which is suggestive but not specific.

quotes.text: General purpose: GAN-based (AdsGAN, CTGAN, PATEGAN, DP-GAN),VAE-based(TVAE, RTVAE), Normalizing flows, Bayesian Networks(PrivBayes, BN), Random Forrest (arfpy), LLM-based (GReaT).

imbalance_correction.rationale: No paper and no class-imbalance mention in the README.
